adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` simply re-renders `@embedding` (an `OpenStruct` built in `fetch_embedding`) without reading params or persisting anything, so `PUT /admin/customize/embedding` is effectively a no-op (`app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb`). The frontend controller’s `saveChanges()` calls `this.get('embedding').update({});` and does not attach error handling (`admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6`). However, the current UI/template (`admin/templates/embedding.hbs`) doesn’t invoke `saveChanges` and the only persisted changes (hosts) go through `EmbeddableHostsController`, so this is more of a misleading/incomplete endpoint that could become a trap if settings are later added, rather than a presently broken behavior proven by the diff.
